ns2:section.sectionText: Seats are reserved for LAS Access and Achievement Program students, specifically EOP and PAP students in the Liberal Arts and Sciences college. If you do not meet this requirement, please contact the Access and Achievement Program Office in 2002 Lincoln Hall to be placed on the LAS AAP waiting list.Open to LAS AAP Undeclared only to June 19. Placement in this course requires a recent U of I Math Placement Exam score of at least 40%, with 50%-64% strongly recommended. Failure to achieve the minimum score will result in removal from the course after the fifth business day of fall term. Students with lower scores are encouraged to work through the Learning Module during the summer until they have reached the level of mathematical knowledge expected for this course. For details see http://math.illinois.edu/ALEKS
